svg.title: The daemon
svg.desc: File (in ~/Library/Application Support/Umbra/): daemon.sock (daemon-<profile>.sock), Purpose: The socket clients connect to. Only your user can open it.; File (in ~/Library/Application Support/Umbra/): daemon.log (daemon-<profile>.log), Purpose: The daemon's log.; File (in ~/Library/Application Support/Umbra/): daemon.lock, store.lock (with -<profile>), Purpose: One daemon per profile; one owner of the store at a time.
